official_current_rules_confirmed_2026_09.market_universe_public_description: Crypto contracts available on Kraken Prop; exact full pair list is exposed in the Prop trading-terminal market selector rather than frozen on the public FAQ.

dh03_translation.reason: Current official Kraken Prop documentation defines a fixed 0.033% per-day margin funding fee charged every four hours, rather than an exchange-variable funding-rate series.
dh03_translation.execution_semantics: Stop Loss and Take Profit orders exist, but exact historical Kraken Prop mark/fill path and spread for the frozen 2023-2024 DH03 timestamps have not been recovered.

material_blockers: Exact current availability of all six frozen DH03 symbols BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB/XRP/DOGE in the Kraken Prop market selector is not publicly enumerated in the recovered official FAQ.

Authoritative historical Kraken Prop executable price/spread/mark stream for 2023-2024 is not available in the recovered public sources; therefore exact historical prop fills cannot be claimed equivalent to the frozen Binance USD-M minute path.
Weekend holding semantics are not separately and explicitly documented in the recovered public FAQ; overnight holding is confirmed.
Kraken Prop API automation is not established by the recovered Prop-specific official documentation and must not be inferred from ordinary Kraken Pro API support.

important_resolution.carry_rule: 0.033% of open notional per day, charged in six equal four-hour rollover intervals
important_resolution.scientific_impact: Unlike DH03 native Binance funding, Kraken Prop carry can be modeled prospectively without reconstructing a variable historical funding series once the position-notional path and rollover timing are frozen. This removes one major source-rule blocker, but does not remove execution/market-availability blockers.

decision.recommended_next_action: Freeze a non-decisional DH03 x Kraken Prop structural proxy using the existing five-value risk grid, exact frozen DH03 trade timestamps/path for mark-to-market proxy, Kraken Prop deterministic commissions/carry, MDL/MDD rules, and report all plan variants without selecting a winner. It cannot produce PROP-COMPAT-PASS while exact Kraken Prop execution and six-symbol availability remain unresolved.
